notes.title: DLC Update
notes.notes:
Hello, there!


We deeply thank you for visiting and playing our game.
If you like our game, please consider supporting us for our another game via [b]purchasing the DLC.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2746950/FADE2__Support_our_fate/

This DLC includes not only some [b]simple skin changes[/b], but also a map on our internal test [b]difficulty level[/b].

Help us recover the Steam Direct Fee, or just a cup of coffee is good enough!
